note: Adapted from the entry in Fauna Sinica, originally in Chinese; species 188, the northern Reticulitermes (F.) speratus is treated at species level, and the synonymy list gives Reticulitermes speratus speratus (Kolbe), Morimoto, 1968 without further subdivision into subspecies, so the entry is recorded here under the nominate subspecies; the soldier and the alate are recorded, and the values in the measurement table are transcribed as given; synonymy, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, head capsule very sparsely setose. Head capsule oblong, head index 0.63–0.72, the sides nearly parallel and slightly widened posteriorly, the posterior margin broadly rounded; frontal peaks slightly raised, the interfrontal area nearly flat; labrum lingulate, the tip bluntly rounded, occasionally narrowly rounded, with 1 pair of terminal setae, the subterminal setae almost invisible, the lateral terminal setae absent; mandibles slightly stout, the apices slightly curved, mandible length 0.58–0.61 times the head capsule length and 0.88–0.92 times the head width; antennae 15–16-segmented; the broad part of the postmentum at the anterior 1/5, the anterolateral margins nearly trapezoidal and slightly concave at the middle, the sides of the waist region nearly parallel, the constriction index 0.33–0.38; pronotum nearly trapezoidal, width 1.50–1.66 times the length, anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, the anterior margin shallowly concave at the middle, the posterior margin slightly concave at the middle, the median area sparsely setose with about 4–8 setae. Measurements: head length to mandibular base 1.65–1.90 (mean 1.76) mm; maximum head width 1.10–1.26 (1.18) mm; head height 0.88–1.02 (0.95) mm; labrum length 0.34–0.43 (0.38) mm, width 0.30–0.40 (0.36) mm; left mandible length 0.97–1.10 (1.06) mm; postmentum length 1.10–1.38 (1.26) mm, width 0.46–0.52 (0.48) mm, narrow part 0.15–0.20 (0.18) mm; pronotal length 0.49–0.58 (0.55) mm, median length 0.46–0.48 (0.47) mm, width 0.80–0.93 (0.87) mm; hind tibia length 0.85–1.20 (0.95) mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark chestnut brown, pronotum greyish yellow, postmentum, labrum, postclypeus and femoral segments chestnut brown, tibiae greyish yellow, wings pale brown and semi-transparent. Head capsule circular and slightly short; fontanelle a small dot, 0.51–0.53 mm from the anterior margin of the frons; compound eyes subcircular, prominence ratio 2%–4%, the distance between the compound eye and the lower margin of the head less than the long diameter of the eye; ocelli subcircular, the ocellus–eye distance about equal to the short diameter of the ocellus; antennae 16–17-segmented; dorsal margin of the head mound-shaped, postclypeus hardly projecting, lower than the vertex and higher than the ocelli; pronotal width about 1.60–1.65 times the length, the anterior margin nearly straight with a shallow median incision, the posterior margin formed by two arcs meeting and rather deeply notched; forewing length 7.04–7.26 mm, width 1.84–1.99 mm, hindwing length 6.88–7.04 mm, width 1.84–1.91 mm, each Cu vein with about 8–10 branches. Measurements: body length with wings 9.95, 9.33, 9.64 mm; body length 5.35, 5.20, 5.20 mm; head length to labral apex 1.30, 1.32 mm; head length to mandibular base 0.95, 0.94, 0.97 mm; head width including the compound eyes 1.02, 1.01 mm; head width 0.99, 0.97, 0.99 mm; compound eye 0.20×0.18 mm; ocellus 0.07×0.05–0.06 mm; ocellus–eye distance 0.05–0.06 mm; compound eye to the lower margin of the head 0.18–0.19 mm; pronotal length 0.55, 0.51 mm, width 0.88, 0.83, 0.84 mm; forewing scale length 0.73, 0.70 mm; hind tibia length 1.10 mm.
